lessons.title: Parameters, triggers, and NULL pitfalls
lessons.intro:
SQLite 3.35+; every question starts with a fresh in-memory database; result order is specified when relevant. Bind values using the database API instead of concatenating SQL. Triggers respond to table changes. NULL uses three-valued logic; NOT IN with a NULL can yield unknown.

Read each snippet, identify its effect, then complete a fragment. Examples are independent unless stated otherwise. Snippets may omit surrounding entry points and standard imports; displayed code is never executed by the tutor.
